messages:
maria-partnerships: Quick sync — AWS APAC expansion request. Partner asked for marketplace SKU IDs + quota numbers and compliance signoff. Go-live target 2026-04-06. Can infra/ops confirm capacity & SKU IDs? cc: @raj_aws_se

aj-ops: Got it. We need exact SKU IDs + expected RPS and concurrency assumptions. Who owns the committed throughput figure?

maria-partnerships: Short answers for now: initial plan = 2 reserved GPU nodes (rtx-6000-equivalent) with burst up to 6. Baseline ~250 req/s, peak ~800 req/s region-wide. I'll paste the partner email below.

maria-partnerships: Partner email excerpt:
"Please provide SKU codes for marketplace listing, expected monthly consumption (tokens), and confirmation of KMS regions. Need approval matrix for co-marketing." 

infra-bot: marketplace-checklist: billing_approval=pending, security_review=pending, quota_ticket=MP-4621 (created).

simon-cloud-partner: Running a quick capacity calc — with batching & KV cache, baseline 250 req/s maps to ~3 reserved nodes + 2 burst nodes for headroom. I'll file the AWS quota request with these SKU recommendations. Action: simon to submit quota request.

clare-legal: Legal flag — we'll need to review the marketplace addendum for APAC. Share a short exec summary + any data residency notes before we sign.

liz-sales: Sales note — assuming go-live, we'll want co-marketing assets + an announcement plan. Need final SKU names for pricing and partner SKUs.

maria-partnerships: Action list I'm collecting: 1) Simon — submit quota ticket to AWS Marketplace entitlements. 2) Aj — verify infra autoscale & burst plan. 3) Clare — legal review. 4) Liz — GTM draft. Also need Growth sign-off for joint announcement.

aj-ops: I can file the Support case but need SKU list and the capacity calc attached. Simon, can you attach the calc and the exact SKU strings (preferably Marketplace-friendly names)?

simon-cloud-partner: Filing support now. Draft case text includes expected monthly tokens=150000000, baseline nodes=3, burst nodes=2. Case created: 082331-AWS-MP. Link (placeholder): https://aws.amazon.com/support/cases/082331 — will update when AWS responds.

infra-bot: config-reminder: for Private/VPC deployments remember to configure KMS key regions. Snippet:
```
kms_regions: ["ap-southeast-1","ap-south-1"]
key_policy: customer-managed
```

clare-legal: Also flagging: any local compliance (APAC) clauses? If customers demand data stay-in-region we need to confirm our Private images + logs routing. Please list any known restrictions.

maria-partnerships: Timeline proposal: submit quota request today, AWS approval by 2026-03-30, internal signoffs (legal + growth) by 2026-04-02, soft launch 2026-04-06. If any blocker, fallback = Dedicated-only launch (no marketplace) — note that for execs.

liz-sales: I've added a placeholder to the GTM calendar and will prep customer comms drafts once SKUs are final.

aj-ops: If AWS approval stalls we have the Dedicated-only fallback. Please ensure infra autoscale policy allows immediate burst without manual steps.

simon-cloud-partner: AWS asked for monthly consumption justification — I included 150M tokens/mo. Partner SE (raj_aws_se) replied it's reasonable and will push the quota internally.

maria-partnerships: Thanks everyone. I'll make a Confluence page and paste the checklist + party owners. Tagging owners: @aj-ops (infra), @simon-cloud-partner (capacity), @clare-legal (legal), @liz-sales (GTM). Will post the doc link here when ready. :thumbsup:
